## Foods & dishes
- [[Central Asian Digital Visual Food Atlas]]: 115 regional items (95 foods at 3 portion weights in g, 20 beverages in ml), with local names in Kazakh, Uzbek, Kyrgyz, Tajik and Turkmen for 83–85 items; no per-item country, no nutrients.
- [[Central Asian Food Dataset]]: images only, no per-image country. CAFD 42 national dish classes (16,402 images on HF); CAFSD 21,306 meal-scene photos, 239 classes, 69,865 boxes.
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 5 dishes, 0 Turkmen-only. [[FmLAMA]]: 3 dishes (57 rows). [[World Wide Dishes]]: 1 dish (Turkmen-only).

## Ingredients & food composition
- No Turkmen FCT. The [[Kyrgyzstan Food Composition Table]] (11 national dishes shared across Central Asia: beshbarmak, plov, manty, lagman, shorpo, mastava) can be combined with the atlas portion weights to estimate nutrients per plate.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[CMAUP]]: 105 plants (103 scraped). [[KNApSAcK Family]]: 99 records (6 edible / 93 medicinal).
- Compounds and health effects come only from the [[Global]] resources ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[NPASS]], [[SpiceRx]]).

## Gaps
- No Turkmen-specific recipes, composition, QA or traditional-medicine data.
